title: Samiopoula (settlement opposite)
description: On the island of Samos, opposite the small islet of Samiopoula on land then controlled by that islets' inhabitants, twentieth-century scholars noted remains of a Roman-Byzantine-era settlement and associated tombs.

properties.description: 1:500,000 scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
